verdict.rationale: First-party docs say chat answers are grounded in your sources with clear in-line citations. Hovering a citation shows the full quoted text, and selecting it jumps to the quote's location in the source so it can be checked in context. That directly serves the verify-against-source workflow. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that citations are accurate, and evidence that every substantive claim (including in generated outputs like reports or overviews) is cited.
